t: The Brackenheath iSpot Frameless is an outdoor slimline LED bulkhead designed for high-performance exterior illumination. This wall-mounted light is ideal for lighting up domestic and commercial entrances, pathways, and outdoor corridors. Delivering 1150lm of cool white light at 4000K, the 8.5W unit features an IP65 rated dustproof, waterproof, and corrosion-resistant polycarbonate body. The frameless opal diffuser provides uniform edge-lit and front lighting. An easy-install fast-fix backplate ensures quick installation, while a lifespan of up to 30,000 hours ensures long-lasting reliability.
b: Fast-Fix Backplate Ensures Quick & Easy Installation
Frameless Design Maximises Light Output & Coverage
Versatile Fitting Suits Domestic & Commercial Sites
